tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Plain white in light, near-black in dark.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, list groups, stat tiles, chips, tags — soft grey tiles on the page, no shadow.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Things that sit on a card or float: sheets, dialogs, the selected segment, fields inside a card, the unit picker.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Text fields and segmented-control tracks on the page. In dark it matches surface, so a raised control on it still shows.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, names, every number and amount. Also the fill of a selected chip and the toast.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text on an ink fill (selected chip, toast).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, units, hints, meta lines, inactive tabs. On every neutral above.

tokens.name: caramel
tokens.usage: The ONE accent: primary button, + button, active tab, links, focus, the Scaled label, checked boxes. Nothing decorative.

tokens.name: on-caramel
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a caramel fill.

tokens.name: money
tokens.usage: Costs, totals, prices, profit. An alias of ink: money reads through size and weight, not colour.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs attention only: missing price, incomplete total, delete. Always with an icon and words.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning banner fill, the delete-dialog icon circle. Warning text on it.

tokens.name: on-warning
tokens.usage: Text on a warning fill (the destructive button).

tokens.name: tabbar
tokens.usage: The floating tab bar: slightly see-through, with a backdrop blur.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind bottom sheets and dialogs.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Noto Sans, hosted on Google Fonts (400, 600, 700). Body is never under 16px.

styles.name: large-title
styles.usage: Screen titles on the tab homes.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Recipe name, sheet and dialog titles.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Card and section headers, recipe card names.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Add your ingredients first, then your first recipe.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Button labels, ingredient names on cards.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Second lines on cards, helper text.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Tab-bar labels, category tags, the edited tag.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Group labels in Settings, set in capitals.

groups.name: Numbers
groups.note: Always tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) so columns line up.

styles.name: amount
styles.usage: Ingredient amounts on the recipe screen.

spacing.note: 8-point grid with a 4 and 12 for tight spots. 16px side margins on phones.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, label-to-field gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside controls; between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between cards in a list.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side margins; card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections; dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Above a screen's large title; before the main button.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state breathing room.

radius.note: Soft and round: pills for anything you tap, 16px cards.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, the unit picker, small tiles.

tokens.name: radius-input
tokens.usage: Text fields.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, stat tiles, the scale bar.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of bottom sheets; dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, tags, the tab bar, the + button.

shadow.note: Flat. Cards are grey tiles with no shadow; only small lifted controls and floating things get one.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: The selected segment and the unit picker — a control lifted off its track.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Tab bar, + button, sheets, dialogs, toasts.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px page-colour gap, then 2px caramel.

tokens.name: tap-target
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for anything tappable.

tokens.name: field-height
tokens.usage: Text fields and the unit picker.

tokens.name: button-height
tokens.usage: Pill buttons.

tokens.name: fab-size
tokens.usage: The + button.

tokens.name: tabbar-height
tokens.usage: The floating tab bar.
